h1: DUI Lawyer Marketing That Wins the Morning After an Arrest
lede: Most DUI clients hire a lawyer within days of an arrest, and many search the night of or the morning after. DUI lawyer marketing has to put your firm in front of them at that moment and answer the phone when they call. We build that system and measure it in retained cases.

answer.question: How do DUI lawyers get more clients?
answer.text: DUI lawyers get more clients by dominating local search and the map pack for DUI and DWI terms, running search ads around the clock, and answering every call live, day or night. Content on license suspension deadlines, first offense penalties and breath test challenges builds trust, while fast intake and clear flat fees close retainers quickly.

market.title: The buying window is short
market.text: Many states give drivers only a short window after arrest to request an administrative license hearing, so people hire quickly. The firm that shows up and answers first usually wins the case.

market.title: Searches spike at night and on weekends
market.text: Arrests cluster late at night and on weekends, and family members often search for a lawyer before the driver is released. Ad schedules and intake coverage must match those hours.

market.title: Clicks are expensive in most metros
market.text: DUI keywords are among the more competitive criminal defense terms, and large firms bid aggressively. Location targeting, strong landing pages and review volume keep cost per retained case in line.

market.title: Flat fees make price a real factor
market.text: Many DUI clients compare fees across several firms before hiring. Transparent explanations of what your fee covers, including the license hearing, help your firm win on value instead of price alone.

sections.h2: DUI lawyer marketing timed to the arrest
paragraphs: A DUI case starts with a traffic stop, a breath or blood test, and paperwork the driver may not fully understand. By the next morning, they or a family member are searching 'DUI lawyer near me' or 'what happens after first DUI'. Our DUI lawyer marketing makes sure your firm appears in the map pack, in Local Services Ads and in paid search at that moment, with messaging that speaks to the immediate worries: the license, the job, the court date and the cost.

We tie ad schedules and bids to when arrests actually happen in your market, which usually means heavier coverage overnight and on weekends. That only works if someone answers. We plan campaigns around your intake coverage, whether that is an in-house team, an answering service trained on DUI screening, or an attorney on call. Your client dashboard shows calls by hour and day, so you can see when retainers come in and adjust spend.

sections.h2: Content that answers license and penalty questions
paragraphs: People arrested for DUI or DWI have urgent, specific questions. How long do I have to save my license? Will I lose my CDL? What are the penalties for a first offense or an aggravated DUI in this state? Can breath test results be challenged? We build pages that answer these questions accurately for your jurisdiction, reviewed by your attorneys, and organized so both search engines and AI assistants can pull clear answers from them.

County and court pages also perform well for DUI practices. A person arrested in a specific county often searches for a lawyer who knows that courthouse. Pages that describe local procedures, ignition interlock requirements and diversion or first offender programs where available show real local knowledge. We avoid any claim that implies a guaranteed dismissal or reduced charge, and we write with ABA Model Rule 7.1 and your state bar's advertising rules in mind.

sections.h2: Winning on reviews, speed and fee clarity
paragraphs: DUI prospects often call three or four firms within an hour. The winning firm usually has strong reviews, answers live, and explains its fee and process clearly on the first call. We help you build a steady review program that respects client confidentiality, set up call tracking and missed call alerts, and write intake scripts that cover the arrest details, license deadline and next court date before discussing fees and retainer options.

Our free plan starts with your average fee, close rate and how many new DUI cases your firm can handle each month. We then price your local market, including cost per click for DUI and DWI terms, LSA competition and map pack strength, and estimate cost per retained case by channel. For many DUI firms, the right launch order is intake fixes, LSA and the map pack, then search ads, then deeper SEO content.

intake.h2: 24/7 intake that captures the license deadline
intake.text: DUI calls come at 2 a.m., on Sunday mornings and during court recesses, and a missed call usually means a lost case. Your intake needs live coverage around the clock, a script that captures arrest date, county, test type, prior offenses and license status, and a clear alert for administrative hearing deadlines. Callers should leave with a booked consultation, a plain explanation of your fee and what it covers, and a text confirming next steps. We track answer rate, time to callback and retainers by source.

faqs.q: What is the best marketing for DUI lawyers?
faqs.a: The best marketing for DUI lawyers combines map pack SEO, Local Services Ads and search ads scheduled for nights and weekends, backed by 24/7 intake. DUI prospects hire fast, so speed and reviews matter as much as ad placement. We build a free plan that prices your market before you spend.

faqs.q: Why is DUI lawyer advertising so expensive?
faqs.a: DUI terms are high-intent, local and competitive, and many criminal defense firms bid on them heavily. Cost per click can be high in many metros. Tight location targeting, strong landing pages, reviews and fast intake keep cost per retained case under control even when clicks are expensive.

faqs.q: Should DUI attorneys run ads at night?
faqs.a: Yes, if someone can answer the phone. Arrests and searches often happen late at night and on weekends, and family members frequently search before the driver is released. Running ads when no one answers wastes budget and damages your reputation.

faqs.q: How can a DUI law firm improve SEO?
faqs.a: Focus on the map pack with a complete Google Business Profile and steady reviews, then add pages for each county you serve, license suspension rules and penalties by offense. Keep content accurate to your state. Internal links between these pages help search engines understand your DUI expertise.

faqs.q: Are Google Local Services Ads good for DUI lawyers?
faqs.a: In many markets, yes. DUI clients search locally and call quickly, which suits the LSA format, and the Google Screened badge adds trust. Performance varies by city, so we compare LSA lead cost and quality against search ads in your market.

faqs.q: What should DUI lawyer ads not say?
faqs.a: Avoid promising dismissals, reduced charges or that you can save a license, and avoid misleading comparisons with other lawyers. Rules like ABA Model Rule 7.1 prohibit misleading communications. We write DUI lawyer marketing with those rules in mind, and your attorneys should review final copy.

faqs.q: How fast should a DUI firm respond to a new lead?
faqs.a: As fast as possible, ideally live on the first ring. Many DUI prospects contact several firms in a short span and hire the first one that answers clearly. Automated text replies and missed call alerts help when a call cannot be answered live.
